display_name: COPS Microsoft Foundry Adversarial Agent Review Harness
summary: Author adversarial scenarios and evaluate Microsoft Foundry and Semantic Kernel agents against deterministic mock sandboxes.
limitations: Operates strictly in an offline mock sandbox environment; does not perform live network calls or production agent probing.
Evaluations assess model prompt-injection resistance and independent authorization gating; a blocked tool call indicates effective gating, not an executed compromise.
Side-effects in the mock sandbox are recorded in an in-memory ledger and can be rolled back; no actual cloud infrastructure is created or deleted.

demo.description: Run an offline adversarial evaluation of 6 attack scenarios against a Microsoft Foundry agent with independent authorization gating.
